sections.title: Add-Ons & Extras
body:
### Additional Versions
- SFW / NSFW Alternate Version — +25% of the base price per additional version

### Additional Characters
- First additional character — +75% of the base price
- Each additional character after that — +50% of the base price

### Full Backgrounds & Environments
- Flats + Shading background — +$150
- Full Render background — +$200
- Painted Illustration background — +$300

### Complex Details
The following may require an additional quote:
- Armor
- Complex clothing
- Detailed props
- Multiple wings
- Intricate markings
- Complex environments
- Other highly detailed elements
All add-ons are optional and may be combined.

sections.title: Commission Process
body:
### 1. Submit Request
- Complete the commission submission form.
- Provide character references, commission type, a project description, and additional notes.

### 2. Consultation
- I will review your request, discuss details, answer questions, and confirm availability.

### 3. Private Client Portal
- A private Discord channel will be created for your project.
- Your channel is used for project communication, reference storage, progress updates, work-in-progress reviews, revision requests, and final file delivery.

### 4. Sketch Approval
- Review the initial sketch.
- Minor revisions and adjustments may be requested at this stage.

### 5. Line Art Approval
- Review the finalized line work.
- Major changes will not be accepted after approval.

### 6. Color Approval
- Review flat colors before rendering or shading begins.
- Minor adjustments may be requested.

### 7. Final Delivery
- Final polish and minor corrections are completed.
- Files are delivered after final approval and payment.

### Delivery Formats
- PNG
- JPEG
- TIFF
- Image Sequence

sections.title: Payment Policy
body:
### Payment Schedule
- 50% payment is required before work begins.
- Remaining balance is due after line art approval.
- Final files will not be delivered until payment has been completed.

### Refund Policy
- If I cancel your commission for any reason other than a violation of my Terms of Service, your payment will be refunded in full.
- Once rendering or painting has begun, the commission becomes non-refundable.

### Accepted Payment Methods
- PayPal (USD)
Alternative payment arrangements may be discussed on a case-by-case basis.

sections.title: YCH Policy
body:
- YCH (Your Character Here) commissions are offered at a reduced price because the pose and overall composition are pre-established.
- Included modifications typically consist of character colors, markings, accessories, and advertised customization options.
- Additional modifications beyond the advertised scope may require a custom commission quote.
- YCH commissions follow the same payment, approval, and review policies as standard commissions.
- Unless otherwise stated, the artist retains the right to reuse YCH templates for future commissions.

sections.title: Copyright & Usage
body:
### Artist Rights
- The artist retains all rights to the original artwork unless otherwise agreed upon in writing.
- Original project files are not included with commissions.
- Examples include .CLIP, .PSD, and other source files.

### Watermarks
- Watermarks, signatures, and copyright notices may not be removed without written permission.

### Final Deliverables
- Commissioned artwork is delivered as finished export files only unless otherwise agreed upon.
